guidance: Publish only files or Desktop-session directories explicitly delivered for the user's goal. Use final for result deliveries, intermediate for stage deliveries with independent reading or usage value, and supporting for additional result deliveries. Intermediate deliveries appear in artifact lists, not conversation file cards. Never publish internal scripts, tool parameters or responses, conversion intermediates, caches, logs, or source inputs merely because they exist or were read. User-requested code or datasets can be deliveries regardless of file extension. Publication captures an immutable revision; check the successful receipt before claiming delivery. Desktop directory publication captures a sorted immutable member manifest and file bytes, including empty directories. Links, junctions, reparse points, special files, concurrent changes, or member/depth/byte limits reject the whole directory publication. Directory cards browse captured members read-only; they do not support exporting a folder, saving/importing it, or opening its mutable source through a file operation. One-shot invocations still publish regular files only.
